{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_79",
      "title": "Cloud SQL uses an outdated PostgreSQL major version",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance uses PostgreSQL 14 rather than the newer PostgreSQL 15 major version expected by the applicable policy, reducing the supported security and maintenance lifecycle."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_110",
      "title": "PostgreSQL audit logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable the Cloud SQL pgAudit flag, limiting database-level audit visibility for security investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_51",
      "title": "PostgreSQL checkpoint logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_checkpoints flag is absent, so checkpoint activity may not be available for operational and security investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_52",
      "title": "PostgreSQL connection logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_connections flag is absent, reducing visibility into successful and attempted database connections."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_53",
      "title": "PostgreSQL disconnection logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_disconnections flag is absent, preventing complete tracking of database session lifecycles."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_108",
      "title": "PostgreSQL client hostnames are not logged",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_hostname flag is absent, limiting the connection-origin information recorded in PostgreSQL logs."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_54",
      "title": "PostgreSQL lock wait logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_lock_waits flag is explicitly set to off, concealing lock-wait events that may indicate abuse or operational problems."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_109",
      "title": "PostgreSQL minimum log severity is not configured",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_min_messages flag is absent, so the policy-required ERROR logging threshold is not explicitly enforced."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_111",
      "title": "PostgreSQL SQL statement logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_statement flag is absent, reducing audit visibility into SQL statements executed against the database."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_14",
      "title": "Cloud SQL backups are disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The backup configuration explicitly disables backups, increasing the risk of unrecoverable data loss following deletion, corruption, or compromise."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_6",
      "title": "Cloud SQL does not require encrypted connections",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "require_ssl is explicitly false, allowing database clients to connect without transport encryption and exposing data and credentials in transit."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_60",
      "title": "Cloud SQL has a public IPv4 address",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "ipv4_enabled is true, assigning the database a publicly routable address instead of restricting access to a private VPC network."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_GCP_13",
      "title": "PostgreSQL statement duration logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_duration flag is absent, limiting visibility into the duration of database statements during investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "UNKNOWN",
      "title": "Cloud SQL deletion protection is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "deletion_protection is explicitly false, allowing accidental or unauthorized Terraform-driven deletion of the database instance."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "variable \"private_network\" {\n  description = \"Self-link of the VPC network used for private Cloud SQL connectivity.\"\n  type        = string\n}\n\nresource \"google_sql_database_instance\" \"metadata_database\" {\n  name                = \"digital-library-content-management-platform-db-metadata\"\n  database_version    = \"POSTGRES_15\"\n  region              = var.region\n  deletion_protection = true\n\n  settings {\n    tier = \"db-f1-micro\"\n\n    backup_configuration {\n      enabled                        = true\n      point_in_time_recovery_enabled = true\n    }\n\n    ip_configuration {\n      ipv4_enabled   = false\n      private_network = var.private_network\n      require_ssl    = true\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"cloudsql.enable_pgaudit\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_checkpoints\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_connections\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_disconnections\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_hostname\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_lock_waits\"\n      value = \"on\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  = \"log_min_messages\"\n      value = \"error\"\n    }\n\n    database_flags {\n      name  =
